models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Benign, near-windless pattern over the islands now - but departure day is still outside any usable model range.
briefing.synopsis: No organised pressure feature is acting on the Aeolians at the moment: the ECMWF IFS 0.25 deg and AIFS runs of 29 Sep 00Z, with ICON-2i at 2 km, all show light NE to N flow of roughly 1-6 kt across Portorosa, Lipari, Panarea, Stromboli, Filicudi and Salina, with a nocturnal S/SE drift at Portorosa and a diurnal veer to N/NNW by evening. Seas are essentially flat - total wave and swell 0.1-0.4 ft on MFWAM (28 Sep 12Z) and ECMWF WAM (29 Sep 00Z). Through 1 Oct the models keep the same pattern: daytime gust peaks in the 10-19 kt band at Panarea and Stromboli on 30 Sep, otherwise sea-breeze-scale air. I have no data at all beyond 5 Oct 23:00, which is where the forecast horizon ends.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Tonight's rehearsal berth is Portorosa Marina, scored fully sheltered as an enclosed marina with all-round protection, with 3.3 kt ESE and 0.1 ft swell at the scored hour. Nothing in the payload would move the fleet off that berth. Note this is the dry-run scoring against live weather, not a forecast for the trip's first night.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: For 30 Sep the models hold the pattern: light E/NE with an early morning lull - Lipari down to 1.0 kt at 06:00 and Salina 1.4 kt - then a midday build to 2-6 kt and gust peaks to 17.7 kt at Stromboli and 19.0 kt at Panarea around 12:00. Note the models disagree at Panarea 30 Sep 12:00, with a spread of 2.4-11.1 kt, so treat the midday number there as uncertain. Any early departure window is wide open on these numbers; expect motoring rather than sailing.

passage_notes.note: Scored 'go' at the horizon's edge: 06:00 window shows 6.2 kt SSE, gusts 11.5 kt, 0.1 ft wave - a run. All five windows 06:00-14:00 score go. Four days out, treat this as pattern only.
3.5-4.2 kt NE to N, 0.1 ft wave, TWA under 20 deg - motoring the whole 12 nm on current output. Last day the models reach; low confidence.

Same light NE/N air, 3.4-4.2 kt, 0.1 ft wave, head to wind. Marina del Gabbiano scores only 'workable' - open from every direction and no anchoring - so its shelter depends entirely on it staying calm.

passage_notes.leg: Panarea → Filicudi, Filicudi → Salina and beyond
passage_notes.note: No forecast data for the trip dates. The 'go' verdicts you may see against these legs are rehearsal runs on 4-5 Oct live weather, not forecasts for 7-8 Oct.

cautions: Departure day is 4 days out and the models only reach 5 Oct 23:00 - the later legs of the itinerary have no forecast at all yet. Do not plan on these numbers.
Forecast stability at 72-120 h lead shows a mean direction shift of 68 deg between runs, so wind direction for the trip dates is effectively unresolved even where a figure exists.
Panarea 30 Sep 12:00 has a model spread of 2.4-11.1 kt and Portorosa 1 Oct overnight 1.0-7.7 kt - quoted means there are not reliable.
Marina del Gabbiano at Stromboli is open through 360 deg with no anchoring permitted; it is only tenable in genuine calm, so keep Panarea as the fallback for that night.
IFS gust values are interval maxima, so the large gust-to-mean ratios in this light air (e.g. 4 kt mean against 10 kt gust) should be read as reporting artefacts rather than squalls.
briefing.confidence_note: The three wind models agree closely on the present light pattern, but the trip dates sit at or beyond the 5 Oct horizon and run-to-run stability at 72-120 h shows mean shifts of 0.8 kt and 68 deg in direction, so nothing here is actionable for departure day.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
